title: Put the skin texture spec in every Seedance prompt: realistic skin texture…
content: Put the skin texture spec in every Seedance prompt: realistic skin texture, visible pores, natural slight unevenness, no filter quality to avoid Seedance’s default waxy/poreless AI look.
